products.name: Sol | Charcuterie Board/Light Cutting Board
products.description: Inspired by the star at the center of our solar system, Sol is where it all began. The design comes from the very first board we made for our own family, built to be shared and made to bring people together. Every board is cut from maple and walnut, so each one has its own grain and character.
products.details: Approx. 18½" × 12½" × ¾" · Food-safe mineral oil & beeswax finish
